Interprétation :

Minime liséré de liquide au sein du récessus supra-patellaire sans épanchement intra-articulaire significatif. Kyste de Baker multi-lobulé et allongé s’étendant jusqu’à 8cm de diamètre CC. Pas d’évidence de complication ou signe de rupture.

Légère anomalie de signal linéaire iso-intense d’allure horizontale longitudinale s’étendant de la corne postérieure au corps méniscal et impliquant la surface articulaire supérieure, suggérant une déchirure d’allure chronique. Minimes changements dégénératifs mucoïdes par ailleurs.

Le ligament collatéral interne est intact sans déchirure. 

Légère atténuation des surfaces chondrales au compartiment fémoro-tibial interne sans atteinte transfixiante.

Petite déchirure radiaire partielle focale au rebord libre à la jonction de la corne antérieure et du corps du ménisque externe. Le complexe ligamentaire collatéral externe est intact sans déchirure.

Légère atténuation des surfaces chondrales, en particulier la surface portante du compartiment fémoro-tibial externe sans atteinte transfixiante.

Les ligaments croisés antérieur et postérieur sont intacts sans déchirure. Petit kyste ganglionnaire intra-osseux sous l’insertion distale du ligament croisé antérieur.

Artéfacts de susceptibilité magnétique en projection du rétinaculum interne et des tissus sous-cutanés. À corréler cliniquement. Est-ce qu’il y a déjà eu une intervention chirurgicale locale à ce niveau ?

La rotule est hautement située avec une légère patella alta suspectée. Il y a un petit foyer d’œdème au versant supéro-externe de la graisse de Hoffa suggérant un syndrome de friction du tendon patellaire et du condyle fémoral externe.

Il y a une atténuation diffuse modérée des surfaces cartilagineuses au compartiment patellofémoral avec une atteinte transfixiante le long de l’apex patellaire et de la facette patellaire externe, avec changements réactionnels sous-chondraux associés, en lien avec une chondropathie sévère. Petits ostéophytes marginaux au compartiment patellofémoral avec petit kyste adjacent à l’extrémité externe de la facette trochléaire externe.

Légère tendinose du quadriceps distal sans déchirure. Le tendon patellaire est intact sans déchirure.

Conclusion :

Déchirure longitudinale horizontale d’allure chronique à la corne postérieure et au corps du ménisque interne.

Petite déchirure focale radiaire au rebord libre à la jonction de la corne antérieure et du corps du ménisque externe.

Légère chondropathie au compartiment fémoro-tibial interne et externe.

Chondropathie modérée à sévère au compartiment patellofémoral avec atteinte sévère, transfixiante à l’apex patellaire et le long de la facette patellaire externe tel que détaillé ci-haut.

Légère patella alta suspectée avec petit foyer d’œdème au versant supéro-externe de la graisse de Hoffa suggérant un syndrome d’accrochage de la graisse de Hoffa/syndrome de friction du tendon patellaire et du condyle fémoral externe.

Pas d’épanchement intra-articulaire significatif. Kyste de Baker allongé non-compliqué tel que décrit ci-haut.

Antecedentes Clínicos:
Obs. Lesión del menisco interno.
Hallazgos:
No hay alteraciones en significativas de la médula ósea.
Ligamentos cruzados y colaterales dentro de límites normales.
Rotura compleja del cuerpo y cuerno posterior del menisco medial con segmento que se insinúa
hacia la región del receso menisco femoral posterior, con edema las partes blandas regionales.
Cartílagos de los compartimentos femorotibiales y de la tróclea femoral sin alteraciones.
Condropatía rotuliana superficial difusa.
No hay significativo derrame articular. Pequeño quiste poplíteo no complicado.
Leve aumento de señal de la inserción distal del tendón cuadricipital y de la inserción proximal del
tendón rotuliano, sin signos de rotura.
Tendones de la pata de ganso, bíceps femoral y banda iliotibial dentro de límites normales. Edema
las partes blandas entre la banda iliotibial y el cóndilo femoral lateral.
Impresión:
Rotura compleja del menisco medial con segmento que se insinúa hacia el receso menisco
femoral posterior con edema de las partes blandas regionales.
Condropatía rotuliana superficial difusa.
Leve tendinosis cuadricipital distal y rotuliana proximal.
Fenómenos de fricción de la banda iliotibial.

There is a complex tear through the body and posterior horn of the medial meniscus, with a small inferomedially flipped fragment being noted at the level of the body, as best seen on coronal imaging.  No significant knee joint effusion, there is however intra-articular fluid within the superomedial and to a lesser extent inferomedial recesses of the knee knee joint.  
Grossly intact lateral meniscus, allowing for mild mucoid degeneration at the level of the body.  Normal cruciate and collateral ligaments, popliteus, extensor tendons and the distal iliotibial band.  Mild distal femoral trochlear dysplasia with no associated patellofemoral articular cartilage damage. 
Well-maintained medial and lateral tibiofemoral articular cartilage surfaces. No marrow signal abnormality of concern, mild edema like signal change noted within the prepatellar soft tissues with no discrete bursal formation.

[DATE].  
Mild mucoid degeneration is present within both menisci, but with no associated tears being demonstrated.  Focal grade 3/4 articular cartilage loss is noted at the junction of the central and posterior thirds of the medial femoral condyle, best appreciated in the sagittal plane. Tricompartmental articular cartilage surfaces are otherwise well preserved.  
Moderate suprapatellar effusion of a nonspecific nature, there are no intra-articular loose bodies.  Intact cruciate and collateral ligaments, popliteus, extensor tendons and distal iliotibial band. No fracture or marrow infiltration. Grossly unremarkable remaining imaged extra-articular soft tissues.

MRI of right Knee with 
-Locator, SG PD FatSat, SG T2W FS, SG T1W, CO T2W FS, AX T2W FS



> The contour of ACL is in a straight line and increase signal intensity inside on F/S T2WI, in favor of grade 1 injury or mucoid degeneration.
> The contour of PCL appears to be within normal, no abnormal signal intensity is noted.
> Linear signal intensity in posterior horn of medial meniscus, without significant extending into the surface, in favor of  grade 2 intrasubstance signal of posterior horn of medial meniscus, maybe due to degeneration or  peripheral prominent vascularity.
> Both medial & lateral collateral ligaments appear to be within normal.
> Joint effusion and suprapatellar bursitis with suprapatellar and medial plicae; hypertrophy of the synovium, indicative of synovitis and bulging lateral aspect synovial recess over popliteal fossa.
> Wearing of articular cartilage of right knee, especially at patellar  ridge and femoral trochlea with subchondral edema over femoral trochlea, reflecting grade 4 chondromalacia of patellofemoral joint
> Patellar enthesophyte and mild tendinosis of quadriceps tendon and patellar tendon.

Impression: 
1. Grade 4 chondromalacia of right patellofemoral joint, reflecting osteoarthritis.
2. Synovitis of right knee with suprapatellar bursitis and patellar plicae.
3. Grade 1 injury or mucoid degeneration of ACL.
4. Grade 2 intrasubstance signal of posterior horn of medial meniscus, R/O degeneration or  peripheral prominent vascularity.
5. Patellar enthesophyte with mild adjacent tendinosis.
Suggest correlation with clinical manifestation

SOL DİZ MRG. Tetkik protokolü: Çok düzlemli, çok sekanslı. Bulgular: Lateral menisküs ve medial menisküsler eklem aralığından ekstrude olup menisküslerde belirgin hacim kaybı, maserasyon ve grade III dejenerasyonlar izlendi. Anterior çapraz bağda komplet rüptüre sekonder bütünlük kaybı izlenmektedir. Posterior çapraz bağ belirgin kıvrımlı görünümdedir. Diz eklemini oluşturan her 3 kompartmanda santral-marjinal osteofit formasyonu izlendi. Tibiofemoral eklem medial ve lateralinde eklem aralığında daralma, ekleme komşu kemik yüzlerde subkondrial skleroz, ödem ve milimetrik kistler izlendi. Bu düzeyde femoral ve tibial kartilajlarda destrüksiyon izlendi. Bulgular dejeneratif artrit lehine yorumlandı.Diz eklemi posteriorunda, popliteus tendon kılıf komşuluğunda snovial sıvının çevrelediği büyüğü 7 mm çaplı ossifiye nodüler lezyonlar izlendi. Bulgular snovial kondromatozis lehine yorumlanmıştır. Diz eklem kapsülü posterior superiorunda yırtık, yırtık ile ilişikli 2.5x1.5 cm boyutlu ganglion kisti izlendi. Diz eklem posteriorunda 3x2 cm boyutlu ekstraartiküler ganglion kisti izlenmektedir. Suprapatellar bursa ve diz eklem mesafesinde sıvı artışı izlendi. Tibianın tibiafibular eklemden anteriora doğru sublüksasyonu izlenmektedir. Patella lateral fasette kartilaj belirgin incelmiştir. Sonuç: Gonartroz.Medial ve lateral menisküslerde ekstrüzyon, volüm kaybı, maserasyon ve grade IIII meniskopati.Anterior çapraz bağda komplet rüptür ve posterior çapraz bağda kıvrımlı görünüm.Medial kollateral ligamende grade I sprain. Diz eklem  kapsülü posteriorunda yırtık ve yırtık ile ilişkili ganglion kistleri.Suprapatellar bursit ve diz ekleminde sinovit.Tibianın sublüksasyonu.Patella lateral fasette grade II kondromalazi.

No significant knee effusion. Normal medial and lateral menisci. No evidence of tears.  Normal ACL, PCL, MCL and LCL. Normal extensor mechanism.  The tibiofemoral and patellofemoral articular cartilage is normal. Normal visualized bones and surrounding soft tissues.  Conclusion: No evidence of meniscal tears or ligamentous injury.

Findings: There is no significant knee effusion. Normal medial and lateral menisci. No evidence of tears.  Normal ACL, PCL, MCL and LCL. Normal extensor mechanism.  Normal tibiofemoral and patellofemoral articular cartilage. Normal visualized bones and surrounding soft tissues. No evidence of hamstring tendinopathy.

FINDINGS: A partial injury of the anterior cruciate ligament is demonstrated - anatomical continuity is best appreciated in the coronal plane. There is in fact no associated anterior tibial translation.  Well-preserved medial and lateral tibiofemoral hyaline articular cartilage surfaces, a subcentimeter focus of grade 3/4 articular cartilage loss is noted at the midline femoral trochlea anteriorly. Well-preserved retropatellar articular cartilage.  There is a significant, incompletely imaged knee joint effusion with nonspecific synovitis, no intra-articular loose bodies are present.  There is a popliteus muscle strain posteriorly, there is however no disruption of the corresponding musculotendinous unit or tendon.  The popliteofibular ligament appears sprained, there is furthermore soft tissue edema like signal change at the position of the arcuate ligament complex, suggestive of a sprain pattern - both limbs of the arcuate ligament can however be appreciated on coronal images (series 301 image 26), implying gross structural continuity.  Both collateral ligaments appear intact, as do the PCL, medial meniscus, patellar tendon, distal iliotibial band and marrow signal characteristics.  A tiny cleft is affecting the free edge of the lateral meniscus, at the junction between the body and anterior horn. Minor non calcific distal quadriceps insertional tendinosis also present. No other finding of note.   
</IMPRESSION/> Partial ACL injury with involvement of the popliteus muscle, popliteofibular and arcuate ligaments posterolaterally. Subcentimeter diameter focus of full-thickness cartilage loss with associated reactive marrow changes noted at the midline femoral trochlea.
